svg.title: M9d: compare the same history before predictions branch
svg.desc: The prefill predicts y0. One-token steps and a three-token causal append produce predictions for the same output positions. Candidate predictions are recorded but the reference tokens are fed back. Comparing query size holds the reader fixed; comparing readers holds query size fixed.

g.text: Same history. Different execution shape or reader.
Reference continuation: y0, y1, y2, y3, y4. Output row i predicts yi from prompt + y[:i].
Prompt prefill → keep the final logit row → prediction y0 (output row 0)
T = 3: one causal append, then a short tail
inputs [y0, y1, y2] → predict [y1, y2, y3]
output rows 1–3; each query can see its prefix, never a future input
If a candidate predicts z instead of yi, record the disagreement.
Still feed the reference yi next. Otherwise later rows would compare different text.
Shape comparison: keep the reader fixed, change T. Backend comparison: keep T fixed, change the reader.
Fixed-history diagnostic only: no draft proposals, rejection, rollback schedule, or throughput claim.
